Tier2 link conversion with accessible names enabled

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert_with_accessible_names('<p>see <a href="https://example.com/x">GitHub<svg aria-label="(opens in new tab)"><use href="#ext"></use></svg></a> now</p>', true, HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(inline_data_media: 'AltTextOnly', tier_strategy: 'tier2'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
